sc.loadingSub: Checking particles, tense, and natural wording
sc.rememberD: You used “어제” clearly. Now match it with past tense and add “에” after the destination.
sc.title: Sentence Feedback
sc.grammarText: ‘어제’ means “yesterday,” so use the past tense. Use ‘에’ to mark a place. (학교에)
sc.tenseText: ‘가요’ is the present form of ‘가다’. For past events, use ‘갔어요’.
